readerCopy.body: What you value now may be asking for different terms than the ones you have accepted before. When Venus opposes the South Node, a relationship, offer, purchase, or money decision can put your current priorities directly against an old pattern of choosing. You may see how much loyalty, chemistry, guilt, or familiarity has been carrying the agreement. The past can explain why the terms made sense then. It does not have to decide what they are worth to you now.
